title: Final-Settlement Refunds to the Original Card or Wallet
content:
**Returns & Exchanges — desk action reference: final-settlement refunds to the card or wallet.**

## The rule

Once a return refunded to the original tenders is in status inspected and its order was paid by card or wallet, the returns desk pays its final-settlement refund to that card or wallet, one payment for the stage and tender.

The final card refund on a return whose type carries a return shipping fee is fixed only after the return carries the return shipping fee entry for the method its parcel travelled by. That refund is not paid until every footwear line whose shoebox came back missing, damaged or used as the shipping carton, on a return whose type carries shoebox fees, carries its shoebox fee entry.

## What the action does

`pay_final_card_refund_b5173030` pays one refund on a return to the card or digital wallet captured on the original order and records it on the return's money ledger, dated today; the payment lowers what is still owed on the return by its amount. It pays only a final-settlement refund to the card or wallet: refunds owed to a stored-value instrument are booked through the instrument's own ledger and are not paid here. After the call the refund appears among the return's settlement entries.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side action of the returns desk, outside the standing tool list: the agent unlocks it by its exact name, `pay_final_card_refund_b5173030`, and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `return_id` | The RMA number of the return being refunded, as shown by the return lookup | Identifier, exactly as shown |
| `refund_stage` | When the refund is paid | One of: `final_settlement` — the refund paid when the inspected return is settled, the only stage this action pays; `instant_credit_at_scan` — the store credit issued at the parcel's first carrier scan, which this action does not pay; `not_applicable` — never a refund stage, refused |
| `tender_type` | The payment method refunded | One of: `card_or_wallet` — the card or digital wallet captured on the order, the only tender this action pays; `gift_card` — a Marlowe & Finch gift card used on the order, refunded through the card's own ledger and not here; `return_store_credit` — existing Return Store Credit used on the order, not paid here; `bonus_gift_card` — a holiday Bonus Gift Card used on the order, not paid here; `goodwill_credit` — a Goodwill Credit used on the order, not paid here; `rewards_note` — a Marlowe Rewards Note used on the order, not paid here; `return_store_credit_new` — a newly issued Return Store Credit, not paid here; `not_applicable` — never a tender, refused |
| `instrument_id` | The reference number of a stored-value instrument refunded | A card or wallet has no instrument reference, so "" (empty) is passed for a `card_or_wallet` refund |
| `refund_amount_usd` | The amount paid back to the card or wallet | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; recorded as a payment out |

## What comes back

- **Success:** a confirmation sentence naming the refund entry reference (a reference beginning "rs"), the RMA number, the stage, the tender and the amount refunded in USD with 2 decimal places. The entry reference means the refund was paid.
- **Errors:** any stage other than `final_settlement`, any tender other than `card_or_wallet`, or an instrument reference returns an error sentence and records nothing; when no return exists under the RMA number given, the action answers "Error: no return" with that number and records nothing.
